=== Usage ===

This template places a small star ([[Image:Cscr-featured.svg|14px]]) in the top right corner of an article to indicate that it is a [[Wikipedia:Featured articles|featured article on Wikipedia]]. It categorises them into [[:Category:Featured articles]].

This template should be placed at the bottom of the article before defaultsort, categories and interwikis.
